findings.text: Prior F-4 is only partly fixed. The prose calls TP-6 supplementary, but it is still listed under S-1/AC1 (and in its frontmatter covers). AC1 describes only a successful search with 12 matches, not an error path.

findings.suggested_fix: Mark TP-7 and TP-8 as supplementary tests traced to design.md#overview instead of counting them as AC coverage.
findings.text: TP-7 (singular '1 patient') and TP-8 (status filter) test design behaviour, but they are mapped to S-1/AC1 and S-1/AC2. AC1 covers only '12 patients' and AC2 covers only search-text changes.

rubric_items.reason: All five acceptance criteria (S-1/AC1-AC3, S-2/AC1-AC2) have at least one test. Every covers entry points to a criterion that exists in split.md.
Only the web changes and the API is unchanged, so web unit tests in the existing PatientsPage test file are the cheapest level that proves the behaviour.
Has a negative test (TP-6) and boundaries at 0 (TP-4), 1 (TP-7, added for prior F-1) and a total beyond the page (TP-3). There is no new endpoint or field.

Tools and folder match the strategy (Vitest, jsdom, Testing Library, web/src/__tests__). Titles still lack the requirement-ID prefix that the strategy and the existing tests use (prior F-2 not fixed).
Titles are concrete and runnable. TP-6, TP-7 and TP-8 are still mapped to S-1 criteria whose text does not describe the behaviour they test.
